task.title: Collaborate on a Note in Real Time
task.shortdesc: Invite others to view and edit a note simultaneously using NoteForge Pro.

context.p: Real-time collaboration requires a Pro subscription for all participants. Both the note owner and any invited collaborators must have active Pro accounts.

step.cmd: Open the note you want to share and tap the Share icon in the toolbar.
Type the email addresses of your collaborators in the Invite field, then tap Send Invite.
Collaborators receive an email invitation. When they open the shared note, their cursor and edits appear in real time in a colour unique to each person.

taskbody.result: The note is now shared, and all invited collaborators can view and edit it simultaneously.
